name: Gumroad
summary: A creator-commerce platform and marketplace for digital products, courses, memberships, and simple software sales.

pricing.headline: Standard direct card sales combine Gumroad's 10% + $0.50 fee with a documented 2.9% + $0.30 processing fee.
pricing.assumptions: Illustrative standard card sale through a Gumroad profile or direct link at the default 10% + $0.50 platform fee plus 2.9% + $0.30 processing. Once paid sales in a calendar month reach $20,000, new direct sales that month drop to 5% + $0.50 (processing unchanged); Discover stays 30%. PayPal, connected Stripe accounts, affiliates, taxes, and refund treatment differ.

currencySupport.presentment: Sellers choose a display currency; eligible one-time card purchases can be localized into the buyer's currency, while other transactions remain USD.
currencySupport.customerCharge: Eligible one-time card buyers are charged the local amount shown. Unsupported local-currency sales, memberships, PayPal, and some connected-account flows can be charged in USD.
currencySupport.settlement: Bank payouts are made in the single local currency assigned to the seller's country; PayPal payouts and unsupported bank countries use USD.
currencySupport.buyerFx: Gumroad uses a mid-market conversion for supported local charges; a buyer's card issuer may still add an international-purchase fee.
currencySupport.merchantFx: Bank-payout conversion uses the rate at the time of sale, with no separately published Gumroad FX percentage; PayPal or Stripe Connect can apply their own conversion rules.
currencySupport.moneyPath: local or USD charge → USD reporting → seller-country payout currency

marketExamples.path: USD charge → USD reporting → USD payout
marketExamples.cost: A US seller receiving USD follows a matched-currency route; card, platform, and payout fees are separate.

marketExamples.path: EUR charge → USD reporting → EUR payout
marketExamples.cost: The local charge is reported in USD and converted back for payout. Gumroad does not publish a separate universal FX percentage.

marketExamples.path: CHF charge → USD reporting → CHF payout
marketExamples.cost: The local charge is reported in USD and converted back for payout. Gumroad does not publish a separate universal FX percentage.

sellerCoverage: Payout method and seller availability vary by country.
buyerCoverage: Gumroad sells internationally and applies tax based on its obligations as Merchant of Record.
products: Digital downloads, ebooks, courses, tutorials, memberships, and eligible SaaS; physical and prohibited categories are excluded.

features.checkout: Gumroad-hosted product pages, profile storefronts, and direct product links.
features.subscriptions: Memberships and recurring products with a creator-oriented workflow.
features.invoicing: Buyer receipts and tax records; not positioned as a complex B2B quoting platform.
features.paymentMethods: Cards and PayPal availability varies by buyer and seller setup.
features.payouts: Direct deposit or PayPal depending on country and account eligibility.

responsibilities.note: Gumroad states that it became Merchant of Record on January 1, 2025.
Gumroad can deliver files and memberships; the creator remains responsible for the product.
Gumroad provides transaction infrastructure while creators support their products.
Creators remain responsible for their business records and income tax.

limitations: High effective fee for standard direct card sales
Less flexible for complex SaaS billing
Marketplace discovery sales use a substantially higher fee
avoidIf: You need advanced subscription lifecycle APIs
Precise low-cost processing is the primary constraint
